instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a Verilog module that combines the given modules: a 4-to-1 multiplexer and a 2-to-1 multiplexer, both implemented using only NOR gates. The system should have an additional module that performs a subtraction operation between the two selected inputs and outputs a 4-bit result. The 4-to-1 multiplexer should have four 4-bit data inputs and a 2-bit select signal that selects one of the inputs. The 2-to-1 multiplexer should have two 4-bit inputs and a single bit select signal. If the select signal for either multiplexer is outside the valid range, the output should be 0.
